one_sentence: The same mathematical architecture governs gravitational force and moral entropy because both are manifestations of the same substrate at different scales.
executive_summary: This document establishes a structural isomorphism between gravitational force (physics) and sin dynamics (theology), arguing that both follow an inverse-square law, require escape energy, and exhibit universal attraction. Key evidence includes the mapping of gravitational mass to moral mass, binding energy to grace, and the forced non-arbitrary mapping that passes four separator tests (structural preservation, non-arbitrariness, constraint, bidirectionality). The conclusion is that this isomorphism is Level 3 (structural), with high confidence and active kill conditions, predicting that civilizations with greater moral mass collapse faster and that conversion experiences show threshold effects.
short_summary: This document is a formal isomorphism paper mapping gravity to sin. The core structural claim is that both phenomena share an inverse-square attractive force with binding energy and escape velocity. Key evidence includes the forced mapping passing all four separator tests and empirical data from 28 cultures. This matters because it bridges physics and theology, generating testable predictions about moral entropy and conversion thresholds.
